results.title: Scammed
results.overview: Millions of Americans have fallen victim to a growing epidemic of online scams, from sextortion schemes aimed at teens to crypto investment scams targeting seniors.  FRONTLINE and Associated Press have spent more than a year investigating this shadowy world that's grown into a global criminal industry, powered in many cases by organized crime, trafficked labor, American technology, and, increasingly, Al.

results.title: Doll of Deceit
results.overview: A woman's affair with a hired handyman takes a dark turn when her husband discovers the betrayal, leading to a suspenseful tale of captivity and an eerie transformation that blurs the line between reality and nightmare. Who will survive?

results.title: How Much Time
results.overview: During the Christmas season, six 29-year-old friends reunite at the funeral of a former schoolmate, almost ten years after they last saw each other. As they confront their unresolved lives, doubts and fears, their reunion becomes a portrait of a generation caught between the end of youth and an uncertain future.

results.title: Ghost Light
results.overview: Actress Marion Neal finds herself mired in a lawsuit over the rights to her playhouse. As strange occurrences begin to take place, the hidden truth emerges regarding an intricate web of interwoven conspiracies and villainous agendas.

results.title: La jangada
results.overview: La Jangada is the union of 35 musicians embraced by nature with a common goal: to bring to life songs that are born from the heart of this country.  In search of the vastness that these songs convey, we wanted to bring a piece of Santiago del Estero's land straight to the Río de La Plata.

results.title: The Audition
results.overview: The short film follows Kim Johnson, a 50-year-old Army major, and her 13-year-old autistic, non-binary child, Ace, on a high-stakes journey to a prestigious music audition in Washington, D.C. What begins with a nervous pickup from school spirals into a frantic search through the music academy when miscommunications leave them scrambling to find the right audition room.

results.overview: Sam Morril delivers savage laughs as he relives his worst one-night stand, compares famous assassinations and details an unorthodox rat extermination.

results.title: My Home of Wind and Sand
results.original_title: My Home of Wind and Sand
results.overview: Since birth, Najla has lived in a refugee camp in the Algerian Sahara. Over the course of ten years, the film follows the activist as she peacefully advocates for Western Sahara's independence.

results.title: The Nice Ones
results.overview: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

results.title: Hager (Land)
results.overview: ​In 1973, the Jewish community of the village of Gonderchomriam in Ethiopia is preparing for a dangerous journey on foot through Sudan to the Land of Israel. Yitzhak (58), an independent farmer and owner of a successful homestead, refuses to leave his hard-earned land and crops, to disconnect from the soil where he grew up, and to set off on a journey into the unknown. His stance leads to a fierce conflict with his wife Sarah (45), who is determined to hit the road with their three children. However, the family's entanglement in a blood feud forces Yitzhak to send Sarah and the children on the journey to Sudan en route to Israel, and to recalculate his life's path.

results.title: Dùthchas: Our Underwater Forests
results.overview: An animated documentary exploring the parallel loss of marine biodiversity and Gaelic culture and language in Scotland. Six interviews with researchers and practitioners,explore marine ecosystems, capitalism, and rewilding alongside a fully animated visual story. The hand-painted animation is based on underwater sketches, giving it a dreamlike yet accurate look.

results.title: The Hammer
results.overview: Simon de Pury is a familiar face in the art world. The former chairman of Sotheby’s has a larger-than-life personality and is known as the «Mick Jagger of auctions.»

results.title: Farewell
results.overview: A short film for NOTODO Film Fest.  In 1936, a man tries to flee his home in secret. But his daughter crosses his path before he can step through the doorway.

results.title: The Grandmother and the Virgin
results.overview: During La Tirana festivities in the north of Chile, a family converse.  Years later, in the editing room, the Super 8 footage of the celebration reveals stories surrouding grandma's childhood.

results.title: Donbass. Peaceful Life. Home On The Edge Of War
results.original_title: Донбасс. Мирная жизнь. Дом на краю войны
results.overview: The film follows an elderly man who chose not to leave his village in the Zaporizhzhia region, finding himself caught in war both in 2014 and again in 2022. He tends his family's graves, grows potatoes in his large garden, and somehow manages to fetch water. Long accustomed to shelling and life without electricity, he accepts it with quiet philosophy, observing that humanity lived without electric light for thousands of years. Members of the BARS volunteer combat unit help him extinguish fires caused by shelling. His only constant companion is the Gospel. His reflections on life, eternity, and peace are deeply personal, shaped by years of hardship. A person who carries peace within can create an island of peace even amid the inferno of war.
